phase4zn_zo_zp_zq_carried_forward.phase4zo: CASE ZO-B, single 3-mode prompt improved small-talk but caused RAG50 completeness regression (P02)
phase4zn_zo_zp_zq_carried_forward.phase4zp: CASE ZP-C, isolated mode prompts excellent (hedge 0/65, OOD 14/15, fabrication 0/10) but deterministic keyword router misrouted 24/50 RAG50 (incl. LC-08) -- dangerous
phase4zn_zo_zp_zq_carried_forward.phase4zq: CASE ZQ-C, retrieval-score routing also unreliable given current single-machine vector DB (score overlap too large)

this_phase_approach: Do not build a new high-recall router. Reuse Phase4ZP's existing keyword categories (FACTUAL_METRIC_KEYWORDS/GENERAL_PACHISLOT_TERMS/STRONG_FACTUAL_MARKERS/OOD_TOPIC_KEYWORDS, unmodified) but change the terminal fallback from a forced guess (SMALL_TALK) to an explicit UNKNOWN state, plus two additional narrow high-precision SMALL_TALK-only signal categories (closed greeting-word list, preference-question suffix pattern) that are NOT open-vocabulary proper nouns and therefore do not violate the 'no giant dictionary / no machine-specific noun list' prohibition.
